ng_cafe_cook.text: Sit anywhere. Soda bread is in the oven, and the scones are in the other oven.
Soda bread rises with baking soda and buttermilk, not yeast, so it is quick. The first time you try it you will wonder why every bread isn't.

then.text: That is all I have, I am afraid. Off you go, and mind how you go.

else.text: Here, a slice for the road. It is still warm. The farm cat believes it is hers.
